data.name: Khulus
data.gender_notes: Khulus is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who has been set free from the bondage of sin and its consequences, or from a difficult situation, or from the influence of an enemy, or from something that was causing distress or anxiety. The name Khulus carries the meaning “Freed, Liberated, Purified” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khulus usually hope their child will grow to embody freed, liberated, purified and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the purification of the soul and the attainment of inner peace and freedom from worldly desires and material attachments.
data.etymology: Khulus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freed, Liberated, Purified.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khulus total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
